$comment: Evidence mapping and ability vectors for @intellectif/lk-practice (criterion 4), generated by scripts/policy-vectors.mjs and run by vectors/replay.mjs. `map` calls mapEvidence with the configuration resolved from `config`; `outcome-issues` calls skillOutcomeIssues; `context-weight` is the weight of each context; `elo` applies each observation in turn; `elo-options` and `elo-read` resolve options and read abilities back; `ability` reads (and updates) a stored ability per stage. Floats compare at a relative 1e-9; integers, strings and null exactly.

auto pass at the fluent bound: easy
auto pass, between fluent and slow: good
auto pass at the slow bound: good
auto pass, slower than slowSeconds: hard
auto pass, no duration: good
auto pass after a hint: hard, partial score
auto pass after a failed try: hard
auto fail: again, correct is the score ratio
checks 3 of 4 under fraction 1: again, 0.75
checks 3 of 4 under fraction 0.75: pass
checks with no total: again, 0
checks 1 of 1: pass, 1
max score 0, passed: correct 1
max score 0, passed after a hint: hard, correct 1
max score 0, failed: again, correct 0
max score 1 after a hint: correct is the ratio
a skill weight exactly at the floor still feeds memory
